content: MS Majlis 10196/2 ff. 52-118 of the Mafāḥiṣ is recorded as copied in 823/1420 and containing autograph sections at the beginning and end with authorial interpolations and marginal explanations; the Beinecke copy is dated 823/1420 with a query and carries an audition note that Ibn Turka read the work and made additions before Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and companions in 828/1425.
refers_to_primary: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 52-118; Beinecke MS Landberg 146
